market_layer.note: Market prices are deliberately excluded from the shadow probability. Future market snapshots should be compared after probability generation.

method_summary: This clean-room shadow workflow is inspired only by publicly described principles used by quantitative sports-analysis organisations: rigorous data quality, independent sporting probabilities, specialist observation layers, scenario simulation, market comparison as a separate stage, and continuous prediction-versus-result feedback. For each runner it combines official rating, weight position, decayed recent form, recency, age/progression, a bounded course/draw prior and optional auditable watcher observations. Monte Carlo simulations perturb both feature weights and latent runner strength; the percentage shown is the share of simulated scenarios won. No proprietary Starlizard or Smartodds model, weights, data or code are used or claimed.
probability_warning: Percentages are experimental market-blind Monte Carlo scenario-support shares. They are not yet historically calibrated win probabilities and must be evaluated prospectively before any predictive-superiority claim.
